all_candidates.topic: Should NEET-UG become two-stage computer-based exam?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Centre informed the Supreme Court on August 5, 2026, it is considering a two-stage computer-based format for the NEET-UG exam.

all_candidates.topic: Should AI be mandatory for all exam leak prevention?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A report on August 7, 2026, revealed experts relied on chits and memory in the recent NEET paper leak.

all_candidates.topic: Should restaurants be mandated to display hygiene ratings?
all_candidates.news_anchor: An August 10, 2026, survey revealed only 32% of consumers rate AC restaurant hygiene as good, with 74% seeking mandatory public display of hygiene ratings.

all_candidates.topic: Should government directly intervene in fuel price cuts?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The government announced a major reduction in petroleum product prices, including petrol by Rs 10.28 per litre, on August 7, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should merchants pay UPI fees above a limit?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Lok Sabha passed the Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026, on August 6, 2026, empowering the government to introduce Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) on UPI transactions.

all_candidates.topic: Is AI in India creating more jobs than cutting?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A Nomura report on August 7, 2026, found India added 83,100 AI jobs, contrasting with an August 9, 2026 survey where 66% of Indian AI workers expect layoffs.

all_candidates.topic: Is a 2-hour deadline for sensitive content feasible?
all_candidates.news_anchor: New IT rules, effective August 7, 2026, give social media firms a 2-hour deadline for removing sensitive content.

all_candidates.topic: Should banks charge for basic SMS alerts?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Some financial institutions, including Ujjivan Small Finance Bank, are revising SMS alert charges, effective August 1, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should companies delay price hikes during festive season?
all_candidates.news_anchor: India's consumer companies are planning fresh price hikes on everyday products due to surging commodity prices, announced on August 1, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should ITR filing deadlines be automatically extended for all?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Income Tax Return filing deadline for non-audit business taxpayers is August 31, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should LPG cylinder prices be more stable for consumers?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Oil marketing companies revised LPG cylinder prices on August 1, 2026, as part of their monthly review.

all_candidates.topic: Are new credit card reward policy changes fair to consumers?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Indian banking institutions are restructuring credit card reward point structures, annual maintenance fees, and service charges, effective August 1, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Will new Tatkal booking rules truly streamline travel?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Indian Railways revised its Tatkal Ticket booking rules and procedural updates from August 1, 2026, aligning token distribution timing with booking opening hours.

all_candidates.topic: Is new fuel export windfall tax good for India?
all_candidates.news_anchor: India increased windfall tax on petrol, diesel, and ATF exports, effective from August 3, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Is the GOBARdhan scheme a game-changer for clean energy?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Union Cabinet approved GOBARdhan, the National Circular Bioenergy Scheme, with a Rs. 23,731 crore outlay on August 7, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should more states adopt PPP in public bus operations?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Government of Madhya Pradesh announced a structured ecosystem for private-sector participation in public transport on August 10, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Is 40% GST on certain luxury goods justified?
all_candidates.news_anchor: An August 2, 2026, update on GST 2.0 reforms highlighted a new 40% GST slab for sin and luxury goods.

all_candidates.topic: Is CKYC 2.0 rollout beneficial for ordinary bank customers?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The government is introducing the upgraded Central Know Your Customer (CKYC) framework, CKYC 2.0, effective August 1, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Was postponing GST e-way bill changes good for business?
all_candidates.news_anchor: GSTN postponed the implementation of proposed enhancements to the E-Way Bill system, previously set for August 1, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Will the new MSME Bill effectively reduce payment delays?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Parliament passed the MSME Development (Amendment) Bill, 2026, on August 7, 2026, aiming to address payment delays.
